title: Mission Timeline Disentanglement
description: Maintain strictly separate version-controlled event ledgers for planned 10h mission vs flown 3h08m actual mission
acceptance_criterion: Two separate CSV files existing and not mixed in runtime

title: Total Vehicle Mass Accounting
description: Account for every kilogram of vehicle mass across liftoff staging payload deployment and disposal

title: Coordinate & Time Standardization
description: All state vectors expressed with explicit reference frames (ECI J2000 / ECEF WGS-84) and time standards
acceptance_criterion: Explicit frame tags and transformation functions on all state handoffs

title: Parametric Master Skeleton
description: FreeCAD 1.1 parametric B-Rep solid generation for core vehicle stages and aerodynamic surfaces
acceptance_criterion: 12 core solids generated with valid geometry and positive volume

title: Hierarchical Assembly Hierarchy
description: Assembly of Booster Ship and Interstage ring with kinematic joint definitions
acceptance_criterion: Assembly document builds and exports STEP without error

title: 100k Component Multi-Resolution Scaling
description: Index 100000+ vehicle components in a relational database without exceeding 2 GB workstation RAM
acceptance_criterion: SQLite DB contains >= 100000 rows with peak RAM < 2048 MB

title: Raptor 3 Propulsion Modeling
description: Model 33 booster engines and 6 ship engines thrust mass flow and Isp across atmospheric altitudes
acceptance_criterion: Thrust and mass flow scale with ambient pressure; aggregate F_thrust == 33 * F_eng

title: 3-DOF Ascent Trajectory Integration
description: Integrate powered ascent from pad liftoff to staging and SECO with variable mass and J2 gravity
acceptance_criterion: RK4 and SciPy solvers reproduce trajectory within 0.1% tolerance

title: Hot-Staging Ring Separation Impulse
description: Model stage separation dynamics with empirical exhaust plume impulse bounded by NASA HECC published integrals
acceptance_criterion: Plume pushback impulse <= 1.90 MN * dt; stages clear without negative relative velocity

title: Synchronized Dual-Body Propagation
description: Propagate Booster boostback return and Upper Stage continued ascent with synchronized 100 Hz state logging
acceptance_criterion: Common epoch and synchronized time stamps across both stages

title: Upper-Stage Orbital Propagation
description: Propagate post-SECO state under Earth gravity and J2 oblateness harmonic
acceptance_criterion: Energy and angular momentum conserved in conservative 2-body limits to 1e-7

title: NASA GMAT Independent Cross-Check
description: Verify orbital propagation independently against NASA GMAT R2026a
acceptance_criterion: Position residual <= 500 m and velocity residual <= 0.5 m/s over 1 orbit

title: Earth-Intersecting Targeted Disposal Burn
description: Execute retrograde burn lowering osculating perigee to sub-surface altitude targeting atmospheric entry interface
acceptance_criterion: Burn Delta-v == 95 m/s; perigee < 0 km; trajectory intersects 120 km interface

title: Atmospheric Reentry 3-DOF Propagation
description: Propagate vehicle from 120 km entry interface to sea level under US Standard Atmosphere 1976 and hypersonic aerodynamics
acceptance_criterion: Continuous trajectory from 120 km to 0 m with step-size convergence error <= 0.05 m at dt=1s

title: Sutton-Graves Convective Stagnation Heating
description: Calculate convective stagnation heat flux and radiative equilibrium outer mold line wall temperature
acceptance_criterion: Sutton-Graves formula matches NASA TR R-376 correlation; peak flux in [0.4

title: Closed-Loop Bank Angle Modulation Guidance
description: Modulate aerodynamic bank angle to null crossrange trajectory error within rate and saturation limits
source_provenance: +45] deg; slew rate <= 10 deg/s; deadband q < 50 Pa enforced

title: Terminal Geodetic Impact Assessment
description: Transform terminal state to WGS-84 geodetic coordinates and evaluate target miss distance
acceptance_criterion: Coordinates correctly classified in South Atlantic disposal zone without misleading claims of recovery
